parameters.name: index_format
parameters.label: Index format: How to parse barcode and quality tags
parameters.help: The index-format string describes how to parse the barcode and quality tags, for example:   i14i8       the first 14 characters are index 1, the next 8 characters are index 2   n8i14       ignore the first 8 characters, and use the next 14 characters for index 1   If the tag contains a separator, then the numeric part can be replaced with '*' to mean   'read until the separator or end of tag', for example:   n*i*        ignore the left part of the tag until the separator, then use the second part               of the tag as index 1

help.content:
This tool uses `Samtools <http://www.htslib.org/>`_ to extract sequences from a
SAM or BAM file in FASTA or FASTQ format.
